title: What a Stablecoin Is
summary: A stablecoin is a token designed to hold a steady value, usually pegged to a currency such as the US dollar. It aims to combine the stability of the reference currency with the portability of crypto.
blocks: A stablecoin is a token designed to hold a steady value, usually pegged to a currency such as the US dollar. It aims to combine the stability of the reference currency with the portability of crypto.

Designs vary: some hold cash and short-term reserves to back each token, others use other crypto as collateral, and a few rely purely on algorithms — a design that has failed dramatically in the past.
The key questions for any stablecoin are what backs it and how transparently that backing is verified. “Stable” is a goal, not a guarantee.
